content.text: Mechanism: chronic erosion, trauma, impingement of supraspinatus tendon; repetitive overhead movements
SITS: supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor, subscapularis
S/SXS: anterolateral shoulder (deltoid) pain w/ ⇣ ROM esp. w/ overhead activities, external rotation, or abduction; inability to sleep on affected side (esp. w/ tears)
passive ROM > active; weakness, atrophy, & continuous pain seen w/ tears
supraspinatus strength test: 90% specificity for assessing supraspinatus involvement
⊕Hawkins: elbow/shoulder flexed 90° w/ sharp anterior shoulder pain w/ internal rotation
Tendinitis: conservative (e.g., shoulder pendulum or wall climbing exercises, ice, NSAIDs, stop offending activity)
Tear: conservative (e.g., PT, NSAIDs, steroid injections) vs surgery
